pairs.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:173 The candidate's message enters the stored transcript only after the paid model call returns, in the same CAS write as the reply, so a message that is accepted and then hits the CAS refusal at line 198 (a spoken turn or brief edit landing mid-call, the case the route names at line 181) is lost along with its reply instead of being recorded before the request that references it.

techniques.evidence: app/api/intake/[id]/message/route.ts:173 Input is written after the model call, not before the request that references it. The sibling companion and devcase chat routes record first.
